locally_available_herbs.name: St John's Wort
locally_available_herbs.use: mood support — FLAG: interacts with many medications; use with caution

where_to_source: green markets (pijaca) in every town, apoteka (pharmacy chains stock herbs), herbal pharmacies (biljne apoteke), health food stores (zdravo hrana prodavnica), supermarkets for basic herbs
dietary_norms: Predominantly Orthodox Christian. Orthodox fasting periods observed by many (no meat/dairy on Wednesdays, Fridays, and during Great Lent and Advent — plant-based food common then). Pork is the most common meat. Dairy very widely consumed. Grilling (roštilj) is a primary cooking method.

herb_warnings.st_johns_wort: Interacts with: antidepressants (serotonin syndrome risk), contraceptives (reduces efficacy), blood thinners, HIV medications. ALWAYS flag this interaction before recommending.
